text:
Ava: Quick check — we need a test plan for the pricing calculator update + FAQ tweaks. Goal: reduce inbound ops questions and route mid-funnel leads to webinar signup. Timeline: launch calc A/B next Tues. Thoughts?

Diego: Love it. Can we show committed vs metered CTA? A/B test CTA wording 'Estimate cost' vs 'See commitment' — also suggest testing microcopy under price.

Priya: Prefer 'Estimate cost' on top funnel. For webinar tie-in, add tiny CTA 'Join pricing webinar' that surfaces when projected monthly > $5k. Use rule: projected_monthly > 5000 triggers webinar CTA.

Sam: Copy draft: "Estimate your monthly inference spend in seconds — tailor capacity & see savings." Webinar CTA copy: "See how teams cut token cost by 3x — join live demo." Will add microcopy for the FAQ accordion.

Lina: Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/pricing-calc — I'll add compact calc layout and an FAQ accordion item 'How are estimates calculated?' with a 2-line explainer and link to docs.

Tasha: Routing proposal: projected_monthly >= $5000 -> AE touch (tag:ae_lead, notify sales@redwood.ai), 1k-5k -> webinar nurture (email drip + invite), <1k -> self-serve nurture. Need Intercom/HubSpot rules. Tagging @ops-bot to create routing rule.

ops-bot: Routing rule created: name=pricing_calc_routes_2026, condition=projected_monthly >= 5000 -> tag:ae_lead; 1000-4999 -> tag:webinar_nurture; <1000 -> tag:selfserve. Rule id: rc-8421.

Ava: Nice. Sam can you finalize copy + modal microcopy? Also add analytics events: calc_open, calc_submit, predicted_tier, cta_click. Diego you own A/B config in Optimizely and the success metric (lead conversion to webinar signup / AE contact).

Diego: On it. Will set up 40/60 split for CTA wording and enable early stop if one variant outperforms at p<0.01. Event mapping: cta_variant -> 'estimate'|'commitment'.

Priya: I'll prep webinar landing page and a short benchmark narrative — 3 mini case studies showing token cost reductions and latency improvements. Will link to webinar from calc modal when projected_monthly >= 1500 as a softer invite.

Sam: Uploading copy v1: https://docs.google.com/document/d/abc — includes FAQ snippets (how estimates are calculated, what discounts mean, committed vs metered). Will iterate w/ Lina tonight. Expect final by EOD tomorrow.

Ava: :thumbsup: syncing w/ sales on handoff doc. Next: quick 15m tomorrow 10:15am PT to lock final copy and routing.

Tasha: Works for me.

Diego: Works.
